name: Admin Products — list, search, detail, barcode

planSteps.description: Enter phone number 923001234567 and click Send Code
Click the Inventory tab in the bottom navigation
The Products page loads showing search bar, category filters (All, Spray, Seed, Fertilizer), product list with product name, company, category badge, variant count, stock status, and barcode number
Only seed products are shown in the filtered list

The product detail page opens showing product image, name, company, category, stock status, price range, stock quantity, variant count, barcode with copy and download buttons, pack sizes with prices and stock, and action buttons (Edit Product, Adjust Stock, Generate Barcode, Delete Product)
The Add Product form opens with fields for photo, product name, barcode with scan button, supplier/company dropdown, category, base unit, stock, and variants
